notes.scope: Named Luck I, Luck II, Mutation I, Mutation II, and Love Potion rows supported by the checked Fish It guides and code coverage.
notes.excluded: Tier III and IV Luck or Mutation Potions and Weather Potions were reported by a social-feed mirror without an independently supported item-level roster. Speed/Haste, XP, Wealth, Coin, code-bundle, and other unsupported event rows were not added.
notes.imagePolicy: No compliant stable row-level art was found. Keep all five item images null and use text-only rows. Do not use UI screenshots, generic flask art, or images from Fisch.
